text: Ilha Verde Rent a Car is a company of Grupo Ilha Verde, the Azorean automotive group based in Ponta Delgada; the group's own site says it was founded in 1971 with the constitution of Ilha Verde Rent a Car and that its family management is provided by founder Antero Gil Rêgo and his children.
short: Ilha Verde Rent a Car belongs to Grupo Ilha Verde, the family-run automotive group founded by Antero Gil Rêgo

source.name: Grupo Ilha Verde: O Grupo
source.quote: sendo constituído por várias empresas do ramo automóvel, com uma gestão familiar assegurada pelo seu fundador Antero Gil Rego e seus filhos
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. English: '(the Grupo Ilha Verde) is made up of several automotive companies, with family management provided by its founder Antero Gil Rego and his children.' Same page: 'Iniciou a sua atividade em 1971, com a constituição da Ilha Verde Rent a Car', and the group's site lists the rent-a-car as its company ('Ilha Verde Rent a Car', grupoilhaverde.com/empresa/rego-costa-tavares-lda-rent-a-car-ilha-verde/). The rent-a-car's own site links this group page in its footer.
